minecraft:scatter_feature.iterations: t.radius = math.random(2,5); t.itx = -t.radius; t.itz = -t.radius - 1; return math.pow(t.radius * 2 + 1, 2);
minecraft:scatter_feature.y: t.distance = math.round(math.sqrt(math.pow(t.itx, 2) + math.pow(t.itz, 2))); t.height = t.distance < t.radius ? (math.pow(t.radius, 2) - (math.pow(t.distance, 2) * 2) + math.random(-2, 2)) : -999; t.height = t.height > 0 ? (t.distance == 0 ? t.height + (t.radius / 2) : t.height) : 0; return 5;
minecraft:scatter_feature.z: t.itz = t.itz + 1; t.itz > t.radius ? {t.itz = -t.radius - 1; t.itx = t.itx + 1;}; return t.itz;
